A new era at Hogwarts begins ✨⚡

The trailer for the new series has dropped and here’s your first look at Harry Potter HBO series:

Here's a cast comparison b/w the movies and the series:
Harry Potter: Daniel Radcliffe → Dominic
McLaughlin
Hermione Granger: Emma Watson → Arabella Stanton
Ron Weasley: Rupert Grint → Alastair Stout
Severus Snape: Alan Rickman → Paapa Essiedu
Draco Malfoy: Tom Felton → Lox Pratt
Albus Dumbledore: Richard Harris & Michael Gambon → John Lithgow
Rubeus Hagrid: Robbie Coltrane → Nick Frost
Minerva McGonagall: Maggie Smith → Janet McTeer

Each season is expected to adapt one book from Harry Potter in a more detailed, faithful way.
Dropping Christmas Day 2026 on HBO.

Do you like this new casting or are the originals untouchable? 👀✨
